_: Doll 2's wearable things (DOLL2.md). make-items.mjs writes every prompt from this file; lib/town/wear.ts names them in the game. Ids are letters only. An outfit is three sheets (front, back, poses: in-place edits of d2-mannequin-*) and their skin keys; a head thing is one sheet a view it shows in. `key`: what a key copy calls the thing, where "the hat" or the slot's word is not enough (Codex's read, 2026-10-17). `solid`: a thing whole inside its outline (hats are, unless false): what its outline closes in is cut with it. `f`: the women's version of an outfit (the owner, 2026-10-17: the first drawings are the men's), sheets do-<id>_f-<type>; `starter.f` the women's starter, do-starter_f-<type>.

outfits.shapes: Every colour has four hard-edged tones: a bright lit edge, the main tone, a shade and a deep shade in the folds, so that the cloth shows clear folds down the coat and the sleeves, and each button, buckle and piece of trim catches one bright pixel. Every shape stays big enough to read at this size, with no speckle. Each solid shape is fully opaque up to its dark outline, with no interior transparent cells or stray pixels outside it. No glow, bloom, halo or cast light.
